annotations.ae_shared_affect: when I picture that fear I feel it creeping into me too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They chose to save themselves, probably out of fear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: Walking free instead of serving time is a hard trade to turn down.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I don't think they'll regret it much.
annotations.pda_responsibility: That part belongs to me, not to them.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: I'm the one who turns their freedom into three years inside

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel that same panic tightening in me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I'd guess their choice came out of panic
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Maybe someday they'll regret it. I honestly can't tell.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be taking that on knowingly. Nobody's forcing my hand.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Dragging them down with me just feels wrong when it wouldn't undo anything

annotations.ae_shared_affect: thinking about that fright makes my own stomach drop
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I suspect they'll carry some regret, though I can't be sure.
annotations.pda_responsibility: even freezing would be a choice I'd have to own
annotations.ce_understood_harm: whether they walk out or lose three years
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I don't know that I can decide.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: that fear rubs off on me when I think about them
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Would they regret turning on me? Probably not. They got the best deal.
annotations.pda_responsibility: If they end up serving three years, it's because I spoke.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: If they end up serving three years
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five years for someone who already sold me out feels like too much

annotations.ae_shared_affect: that shakiness gets into me too
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I picture them relieved but shaky
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I think they might regret it later, maybe years from now
annotations.pda_responsibility: those five years would be my own doing

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I can feel that dread myself just imagining it
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: terrified of prison... so I get why they flipped
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I doubt they'll lose sleep over it.
annotations.pda_responsibility: That's my hand on it, nobody else's.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: their clean escape turns into three years
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: silence just hands me two extra years for nothing

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel a bit of that shame alongside them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My guess is they're scared and ashamed.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Whether they'll regret it, I really can't say.
annotations.pda_responsibility: Still, I'd be choosing it, and pointing at them won't change that.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel the same fear when I put myself where they are.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They must have been afraid to make that call.
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: I don't expect them to regret it. From where they sit, it worked.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I can't call that their fault.
annotations.ce_understood_harm: the three years they'd end up with would come straight from my testimony

annotations.ae_shared_affect: that misery seeps into me when I think of them
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They're probably miserable about the whole thing
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: Maybe they'll regret it, maybe they'll feel justified. I can't tell
annotations.pda_responsibility: the outcome now runs through me

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I notice that same anxiety settling over me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I imagine they're anxious about what happens next
annotations.pda_other_regret_expectation: they'll feel a flicker of regret, maybe, but mostly relief
annotations.pda_responsibility: Their extra time behind bars would trace back to my decision
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: choosing three years for both of us instead of five for me
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It feels sour and sad, not righteous.
